name: NLP Cloud Augmentor
description: Provides integration of Augmentor with the NLP Cloud API, exposing eight NLP Cloud tasks as Augmentor plugins.
project_description: NLP Cloud Augmentor provides an implementation of Augmentor plugins that let Augmentor interface with NLP Cloud's REST API. NLP Cloud serves high-performance pre-trained and custom models for NER, sentiment analysis, classification, summarization, keywords and keyphrases extraction, headline generation, text generation, blog post generation, and machine translation in 200 languages. The module ships eight Augmentor plugins (entities/NER, classification, summarization, headline generation, keywords & keyphrases extraction, text generation, blog post generation, translation) that all extend a shared NPLCloudBase and call the nlpcloud/nlpcloud-client PHP SDK. The NLP Cloud API key is stored and read through a Key entity via the Augmentor base framework, and requests go to the fixed https://api.nlpcloud.io endpoint. It depends on the Augmentor module and does not define its own routes or permissions; augmentor administration is gated by Augmentor's 'administer augmentors' permission. Maintained by developers at Morpht.
